age_adaptations.note: Do not infer or collect age. Age-specific packages require separate review.

adaptation_rules: Do not attribute one cognitive or civilizational pattern to all speakers of a language.
Separate translation, interpretation, and cultural hypothesis; cite sources for factual claims.
Preserve provenance, author credit, license, and a route back to the source version.
Do not include personal data, private vault material, credentials, or third-party records.
